faqs.question: Can I use this Gummy every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using these gummies every day.

faqs.question: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
faqs.answer: We recommend speaking to a healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can Magnesium Glycinate help with stress?
faqs.answer: Yes, Magnesium Glycinate is known to help reduce stress by balancing neurotransmitter levels and lowering stress hormones.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects of taking Magnesium Glycinate?
faqs.answer: Magnesium Glycinate is generally well-tolerated. However, taking excessive amounts may lead to mild gastrointestinal discomfort. Always stick to the recommended dosage.

faqs.question: Can I take Magnesium gummies along with other supplements, like Biotin?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can. Magnesium also supports the function of other vitamins and minerals.

faqs.question: Are there any allergens in the product?
faqs.answer: Check the specific product label for allergen information, but most Magnesium Glycinate products are formulated to be free from common allergens like gluten, dairy, or soy.

faqs.question: What are magnesium gummies made of?
faqs.answer: Magnesium gummies are chewable supplements that provide magnesium glycinate, malate, magnesium taurate, magnesium citrate & Liposomal Magnesiumin all in an easy-to-take gummy format, designed for moms and women.

faqs.question: Does magnesium help with sleep?
faqs.answer: Magnesium supports normal muscle and nerve function, which can support relaxation as part of a night routine. These gummies are non-habit-forming and are designed to be taken as directed before bedtime.

faqs.question: Are magnesium gummies better than magnesium glycinate tablets?
faqs.answer: Gummies are great for those who dislike swallowing tablets. These gummies are made with chicory root fibre base that helps support nutrient absorption.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of magnesium gummies for women?
faqs.answer: Magnesium supports muscle and nerve function, energy production and bone health. Little Joys Magnesium Gummies can help in sleep, relaxation and stress support for women.

faqs.question: What is the best time to take Little Joys Magnesium Gummies?
faqs.answer: Take two gummies post meal everyday, 1–2 hours before bed.

faqs.question: Do magnesium gummies have side effects?
faqs.answer: These gummies are generally safe for daily use. However, if you’re pregnant, breastfeeding, or have any medical condition, we recommend consulting your healthcare professional before use.
